info.name: Get usage details for a process

params.name: processVersion
params.description: Only return usage details for the specified process version.

params.name: _timeFrom
params.description: Start date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: _timeTo
params.description: End date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: userAccounts
params.description: Filter by user accounts in Domain\username format. Maximum 50 items.

params.name: computerNames
params.description: Filter by computer names. Maximum 100 items. Unknown names are resolved to -1 and match nothing.

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

items.docs: Returns usage details for the specified process including usage per machine, per user account, peak concurrent instances, and unique user count throughout the search period.

info.name: Get usage details for all processes

params.name: _timeFrom
params.description: Start date of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: _timeTo
params.description: End date of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: userAccounts
params.description: Filter by user accounts in Domain\username format. Maximum 50 items. An empty list is treated as no filter.

params.name: computerNames
params.description: Filter by computer names. Maximum 100 items. Unknown names are resolved to -1 and match nothing. An empty list is treated as no filter.

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

items.docs: Returns usage details for all processes (number of unique users and, when no filters are supplied, peak concurrent users) per calendar day throughout the search period. When computerNames or userAccounts filters are supplied, peak_concurrency is omitted and the maximum date span is 90 days.
